caption:
JavaScript on the page runs on one main thread, which also handles clicks, typing and painting. A 2-second loop there means 2 seconds of frozen page.

A Worker runs your script in the background. You send it data with postMessage and get the result back in onmessage.

Workers can't touch the DOM. They're for pure computation: parsing a big file, filtering a large list, image processing.

Source: MDN, Using Web Workers.
